description: Traefik ingress observability from OTLP traces (uslab-eng-01): KPI header, ingress RED, errors/SLO, latency, routers/services, backends. Scoped to serviceName='traefik'.
title: Traefik Ingress (Traces)

widgets.description:
## Traefik Ingress — Overview
Request health for the cluster edge (`serviceName='traefik'`), built from **OTLP traces**. Tiles below are last-selected-range KPIs; green→red = healthy→degraded. *Infra metrics (connections, TLS, cert expiry, config reloads) live in the Grafana "Traefik Ingress" dashboard.*
widgets.text:
## Traefik Ingress — Overview
Request health for the cluster edge (`serviceName='traefik'`), built from **OTLP traces**. Tiles below are last-selected-range KPIs; green→red = healthy→degraded. *Infra metrics (connections, TLS, cert expiry, config reloads) live in the Grafana "Traefik Ingress" dashboard.*

filter.expression: serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Server' AND http.response.status_code >= 400 AND http.response.status_code < 500

widgets.description:
### Ingress — traffic entering Traefik
EntryPoint (server) spans: one per incoming request. Rate, status mix, methods, and HTTP protocol version (HTTP/1.1 vs 2 vs 3).
widgets.text:
### Ingress — traffic entering Traefik
EntryPoint (server) spans: one per incoming request. Rate, status mix, methods, and HTTP protocol version (HTTP/1.1 vs 2 vs 3).

filter.expression: serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Server' AND http.response.status_code EXISTS
serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Server' AND http.request.method EXISTS

widgets.description: HTTP/1.1 vs HTTP/2 vs HTTP/3 adoption

filter.expression: serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Server' AND network.protocol.version EXISTS

widgets.title: Requests by HTTP Protocol

widgets.description:
### Errors & SLO
Error rates and the worst-offending endpoints/backends. **Latency (excl. WebSocket)** drops `101 Switching Protocols` upgrades so long-lived streams don't skew percentiles.
widgets.text:
### Errors & SLO
Error rates and the worst-offending endpoints/backends. **Latency (excl. WebSocket)** drops `101 Switching Protocols` upgrades so long-lived streams don't skew percentiles.

filter.expression: service.name = 'traefik' AND operation = 'EntryPoint' AND http.status_code >= 400 AND http.status_code < 500
serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Server' AND http.response.status_code >= 400 AND url.path EXISTS
serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Client' AND http.response.status_code >= 400 AND server.address EXISTS

widgets.description:
### Latency
Request-duration percentiles. Compare raw vs WebSocket-excluded, and see which routers are slow.
widgets.text:
### Latency
Request-duration percentiles. Compare raw vs WebSocket-excluded, and see which routers are slow.

widgets.description:
### Routers & Services
**Router** = Traefik routing rule (the `Host(...)` match). **Service** = the backend pool it forwards to.
widgets.text:
### Routers & Services
**Router** = Traefik routing rule (the `Host(...)` match). **Service** = the backend pool it forwards to.

filter.expression: serviceName = 'traefik' AND traefik.router.name EXISTS AND http.route EXISTS
serviceName = 'traefik' AND traefik.router.name EXISTS AND http.route EXISTS

widgets.description:
### Backends — upstream services
ReverseProxy (client) spans: timing and status of calls Traefik makes to upstream pods (`server.address`).
widgets.text:
### Backends — upstream services
ReverseProxy (client) spans: timing and status of calls Traefik makes to upstream pods (`server.address`).

filter.expression: serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Client' AND server.address EXISTS
serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Client' AND server.address EXISTS
serviceName = 'traefik' AND spanKind = 'Client' AND http.response.status_code EXISTS
